assemblies.title: 14. 'Right Foot & Right Hand for the Job' — 12-Action Interactive Trust Matrix
assemblies.poem: All 14 Poems — Verified Limb-to-Extremity Pairing & Cuff-Tuck Audit
assemblies.summary: Interactive 12-action verification matrix proving we have the exact right foot card (`flat`, `heel_up`, `toe_up`, `threequarter`, `front`, `boot_front`) and right hand card (`relaxed`, `open`, `grip`, `pinch`, `flat_push`, `cup`, `point`, `fist`) properly scaled, rotated, and cuff-tucked for every action in the film.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 1. Walk Cycle — Heel-Strike Contact
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Shin clipped at y=1295 (0.843h) OVER boot shaft; Forearm clipped at y=1238 (0.806h) OVER wrist crease.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 2. Walk / Stand — Planted Flat Stance
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Sole pinned to floor_Y; boot pull-tab tucked behind ribbed jogger cuff.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 3. Walk / Run — Toe Push-Off Drive
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Ball of foot pinned while heel lifts -24°; ankle tucked inside pant cuff.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 4. Deep Kneel on Ledge (Weave P04)
trust_matrix_rows.poem_context: Weave P04 / Poem 04 (Putting On the Hands)
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Bare forearm grommet (y=1320) snaps onto hand grommet (y=190), then tucks into cuff (y=1195).

trust_matrix_rows.title: 5. Crouch & Pluck Mustard Flower
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Crouch height compensated to 0.36 stage_H; pinch fingers align with flower stem.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 6. Motorcycle Footpeg Straddle & Throttle Grip
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Near leg (z=10..12) in front of bike frame (z=6); far leg (z=1) behind frame.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 7. Ballroom Waltz 3/4 Rise & Frame Hold
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: 3/4 foot matches 3/4 torso yaw; wrist tucked under suit/tracksuit cuff.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 8. Tambourine Windup & Release Whip
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Swaps from grip.palm to open.palm at release apex (t=0.42).

trust_matrix_rows.title: 9. Phone Booth Step-In & Receiver Hold
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Forearm bends -95° upward to ear; cuff overlaps wrist crease cleanly.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 10. DJ Vinyl Platter Scratch & Crossfader
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Flat-push hand oscillates +-18° over spinning platter while fader hand pinches knob.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 11. Horizon Callout & Directional Point
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: 2.5D limb foreshortening scales arm length cos(theta_z) while boosting hand 1.18x.

trust_matrix_rows.title: 12. Kit3/v2 Horizontal Hand (+90° Cuff-Tuck Fix)
trust_matrix_rows.foot_label: body.front.foot.L.png (42×74 Vertical Foot Tucked Under Shin)
trust_matrix_rows.cuff_tuck_rule: Rotates 74×43 horizontal hand +90° around (0.24w, 0.48h) and tucks behind 0.86h clipped forearm.
